title: NIST 200 mm hafnia-on-silicon wafer metrology collection

equation_quality.supported_scope: See exact linked equations and parameter states; successful replay is not mechanism identification.

independent_units.independent_unit_description: Complete deposition batch is the split unit; wafer is the primary aggregation unit. All positions on a wafer stay together. Three deposition batches develop; fourth confirms.

calibration_burden: Five native intensity samples near2theta1.0deg per spectrum; no other held-out intensity is a predictor. Same calibration for every model.

baseline_strength.scope: Matched task/input access; historical controls are not claimed to exhaust state of the art.

practical_relevance.prediction_time: Predict higher-angle intensity after measuring a fixed low-angle calibration band of the same spectrum. Position and angle are known acquisition settings.
practical_relevance.claim_blockers: Positions share wafers and deposition batches; metrology is not independent device replication.

promotion_conditions: Reassess only under a versioned contract; never rename exposed outcomes as fresh.
Resolve each stated measurement/information restriction with source-bound evidence.
Demonstrate a nondegenerate task with grouping adequate for its explicitly claimed transfer; retain limited scope if the present data cannot do this.

practical_use_contract.decision_or_analysis: Estimate native higher-angle XRR intensity under the exact registered input budget
practical_use_contract.intended_user: Domain researcher or process analyst; operational adoption not demonstrated
practical_use_contract.inputs_available_when: Predict higher-angle intensity after measuring a fixed low-angle calibration band of the same spectrum. Position and angle are known acquisition settings.
practical_use_contract.calibration_requirement: Five native intensity samples near2theta1.0deg per spectrum; no other held-out intensity is a predictor. Same calibration for every model.
practical_use_contract.calibration_cost: Not monetized or timed in the corpus; no zero-cost assumption
practical_use_contract.actionable_output: native higher-angle XRR intensity in counts
practical_use_contract.failure_boundary: Positions share wafers and deposition batches; metrology is not independent device replication.

default_numerical_evidence.lowest_error_interpretation: Retrospective description of all frozen alternatives, including attempts and possible aliases; not a new selection or independent baseline.
